text: I was in New York at Christmas.
The streets were full of people.
It was a very funny day.

When I was nineteen, my family and I were in New York for Christmas. It was very cold, and there was snow on the streets. The Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center was huge. My dad was very excited about the ice rink. But on the ice, he was very nervous! I was next to him all the time. Was it a perfect day? No, it wasn't. But we were so happy.

I was at the Rockefeller Center rink for forty years. I was the person with the skates. Every December, the crowd was big, and the visitors were from everywhere: Brazil, Japan, Italy. My favorite visitors? The fathers. They were always sure: "I was a great skater when I was young!" Then they were on the ice, and their children were the teachers. It was always funny.

Carlos was in New York with his family at Christmas. There was a big Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center. Carlos was the teacher, and all the theory was perfect. Then the skates were on his feet. On the ice, his legs were not strong. His daughter was the teacher, and it was very funny.
I was in New York at Christmas.
The streets were full of people.
It was a very funny day.
